arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import math

# Values in thousands of dollars
fy1939 = 820157
fy1941 = 1011262

# Calculate constant hazard rate: V1941 = V1939 * (1 + r)^2
# So r = (V1941/V1939)^(1/2) - 1
ratio = fy1941 / fy1939
r = math.sqrt(ratio) - 1

print(f'FY1939 value: {fy1939}')
print(f'FY1941 value: {fy1941}')
print(f'Ratio (FY1941/FY1939): {ratio}')
print(f'Constant hazard rate: {r}')
print(f'Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(r, 3)}')
"
